details:
Redefine avatar performance rank's evaluation 

  Through away the old performance rank and get a score about 'Required Performance Quantity'.

  My opinion is that avatar can get a performance score with out maximum value and player can block avatars correctly . And with the hardware upgrading , the score won't need to be update. It more likely to show how much performance players need to pay for this avatar.

  The difference between the performance rank like 'poor' and 'very poor' is maybe just an avatar got 70001 triangles. And it's just because it got only the one more triangle. Definitely, if other parameters are the same,

it won't affect too much. And obviously, the way now VRCAHT defines an avatar's performance rank is improper.

  Maybe we can try to think which parameters have huge impacts on the performance releasing. And don't let the avatar actually optimized to be blocked.

  Maybe we can recalculate the weight of all the parameters. And tryna to calculate a rough score of the avatar. Or maybe collect more hardware information to take a benchmark for their avatar locally before the upload their avatar.
title: Redefine avatar performance rank ‘s evaluation
